hero.headline: Authentic Home-Cooked Bukhari Rice & Specialty Lamb
hero.subHeadline: Freshly prepared in small, high-quality batches for family gatherings and intimate events.

about.heading: Heritage, Quality & The Comfort of Home
about.paragraph1: Every dish that leaves our kitchen carries generations of tradition. We believe great food is never rushed, which is why we prepare every order in small, carefully managed batches.
about.paragraph2: We source premium local and imported lamb breeds, selecting each cut for tenderness, flavor, and the unmistakable aroma that only slow, home-style cooking can create.
about.paragraph3: From intimate family dinners to small celebrations, our home kitchen is built on trust, hospitality, and the promise of food that tastes like it was made for family — because it is.

pricing.heading: Our Packages & Pricing
pricing.inclusionsText: All orders include FREE delivery and our signature sides: Fresh Yogurt, Shatni (Spicy Blended Salad), and Normal Green Salad.

suakniSpring.name: Suakni Spring / Labani
suakniSpring.description: Tender spring lamb, gently seasoned and slow-cooked for a light, crowd-pleasing flavor.

whiteSuakni.name: White Suakni
whiteSuakni.description: A refined, mildly spiced lamb with a creamy, aromatic finish — perfect for elegant gatherings.

hari.name: Hari
hari.description: Rich, boldly spiced lamb for those who love deep, traditional flavors and generous portions.

step1.title: Select Your Lamb & Date
step1.description: Choose your package and event date. Remember: max 2 lambs or 60 servings per order.

step2.title: Submit Request
step2.description: Fill out the booking form below and we will receive your details instantly.

step3.title: Down Payment & Confirmation
step3.description: Lock in your event date with a deposit arranged quickly and securely via WhatsApp.

step4.title: Fresh Delivery to Your Door
step4.description: Your order arrives piping hot with all included sides, ready to impress your guests.

booking.heading: Book Your Gathering
booking.subtext: Fill in your details and we will prepare your personalized WhatsApp booking message. No backend required — your inquiry goes straight to us.
